The bug was in `rtl/sync_fifo.v`: `rd_ok` didn't check `!empty` (allowing underflow to corrupt `rd_ptr`/`dout`), and the `count` update logic didn't handle the simultaneous read+write case correctly (it incremented instead of holding count steady). Both are fixed now.

The design is fixed — simulation output shows `TEST PASSED` with no failures.
